entries.text: Doris now waits until a backend is alive and reports disk capacity before creating tables, and its compose healthcheck requires the same, so the first cells no longer fail with "Failed to find enough backend"; header lines of CSV data files are skipped on Stream Load and INSERT loads, H2O-DB Q9 uses PERCENTILE_APPROX, Write and Transaction Primitives quote staging tables with backticks, and TPC-H Havoc variants avoid FILTER clauses and empty GROUP BY on Doris.

The Databend compose stack runs on local storage in a single service instead of depending on the minio/minio and minio/mc images that Docker Hub no longer serves, so `docker compose up --wait` succeeds.
